title: Network cable unplugged message
symptom: PC shows a 'network cable unplugged' message
user_description: My PC says 'network cable unplugged' and I've got no internet or shared drives.

options.why: Costly and far too early. One PC shows the message, so a single loose cable is much more likely.
Never the first step. A cable message is a physical clue that points at the cable.

options.text: Check the network cable is firmly plugged into the PC and the wall port, and try another cable or port
options.why: The message literally says the cable is unplugged or not detected. A loose, damaged or wrong-port cable is the likeliest cause, so check connections and swap if needed.

hints: What does the message tell you about where the problem is?
How can you test whether the cable or the port is at fault?
real_world_tip: Look at the small lights on the network port. If they are off, the link is not working at all.
